batch_node.name: rampart-20x-playground inventory page v0.3.0
batch_node.description: The /playground/inventory page: nine standard table panels, each bound by USES_SEARCH to a Search over the inventory dimension (req-rampart-20x-playground-inventory-tables). Carries no dcom value (req-rampart-20x-playground-nongoals-4).

node.name: playground — inventory applications
node.description: Every entity whose `inventory` dimension is `applications` (req-rampart-20x-playground-inventory-tables). Envelope mode, so the table receives each node with its typed fields.

node.name: Applications
node.description: The running programs of the deployment: the TAP web program, gunicorn that hosts it, and the PostgreSQL database instance. The managed service that runs the database is a cloud-services row. Version is blank where the mock does not claim one. Ports, container, runtime, vendor, whether it is public, FIPS status and open findings are not shown: no field or edge holds them yet.

node.name: playground — inventory crypto
node.description: Every `crypto_provider` stamped `inventory: crypto`, grouped by provider: one row per provider with the number of files it was found in (req-rampart-20x-playground-page-inventory-9, -11). Projection mode, so the table receives the named fields.

query: RETURN n.entity_type AS entity_type, n.data.provider AS provider, n.data.provider_kind AS provider_kind, n.data.boundary AS boundary, n.data.fips_validation AS fips_validation, n.data.rationale AS rationale, COUNT(n) AS files

node.name: Crypto
node.description: The cryptographic implementations the crypto-BOM scan found in the web image, one row per provider, with the reviewed decision about each and the number of files it was found in. No key material, fingerprint or file content is shown.

node.name: playground — inventory secrets
node.description: Every entity whose `inventory` dimension is `secrets` (req-rampart-20x-playground-inventory-tables). Envelope mode, so the table receives each node with its typed fields.

node.name: Secrets
node.description: Secret material by kind and where it is held, never by value: the load balancer's ACM certificate, and the container's certificate with its file and its public and private halves. Values, file contents and fingerprints are not recorded. Secrets Manager secrets and the KMS key appear under cloud services as the resources that hold them; there is no secret or key-material node type and no edge from a holder to what it holds. Rotation, expiry, who uses it and what protects it are not shown.

node.description: Every entity whose `inventory` dimension is `cloud` (req-rampart-20x-playground-inventory-tables). Envelope mode, so the table receives each node with its typed fields.

node.name: Cloud Services
node.description: The AWS resources of the deployment that are neither application, library nor operating system, one row per resource. Subnets and the VPC are conceptual containers and have no row; the ECS tasks are instances of the product image and are not listed. Scheme, encryption and Multi-AZ show only where the resource type has the field; a dash means not observed. ARN or ID, FIPS endpoint, who manages it and open findings are not shown: the ARN lives in a differently named field on each type, and nothing holds the rest.
